title: S3: Multi-class plumbing (N-1 features, real probabilities, fake Jev)
description:
## Purpose

Remove the binary assumptions so all arms work for 6 classes.

## Scope

Few-shot and kNN features use N-1 values from the corpus labels (`unified_loop.py` TASK / FEWSHOT_FEATURE, `unified_knn.py`); `_fewshot_diagnostic` multi-class; `ScoreRubric.predict` in `unified_bundles.py` passes real probabilities; fake Jev with one cue per class.

## Specs (first, beside the module)

N-1 feature names for 6 labels; probabilities sum to 1 and match the head; fake Jev returns the cued class; planted path unchanged.

## Reuse

`knn_feature_names`, `unified_fake_jev`.

## Definition of done

Planted behaviour unchanged (replays byte-identical); 6-class specs pass.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
